tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground under every screen. Always dark; the grain and glow sit on it.

tokens.name: canvas-glow-a
tokens.usage: Main bloom in the Canvas gradient. Berkeley Blue on the Berkeley theme. Surfaces only, never text.

tokens.name: canvas-glow-b
tokens.usage: Second bloom in the Canvas gradient (Founders Rock on Berkeley). Surfaces only.

tokens.name: canvas-glow-c
tokens.usage: Warm streak low in the Canvas gradient, kept under 35% opacity. Surfaces only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: concert, artist, match, info. Holds ink, ink-muted and accent text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, the other person's chat bubble, sheets. Holds ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: School brand regions: match card header, your own chat bubble, selected rows. Berkeley navy lives here, never as text. Holds ink and accent.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: secondary buttons, inputs, unselected chips. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the Melos wordmark, on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, hints, on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels on canvas and surface. Not for anything a person must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: School accent (California Gold on Berkeley). Primary buttons, selected states, the Melos number, accent text on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind accent text: selected chips, the shared artist line.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Over 3:1 on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed states (ticket bought, info sent), always with a check icon and a word. Text on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, always with an icon and a sentence that says how to fix it. Text on canvas and every surface.

tokens.name: spotify
tokens.usage: Spotify connect button fill only. Never recolored by a school theme.

tokens.name: on-spotify
tokens.usage: Label and logo on the spotify fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the wordmark and text when a school image sits under them.

tokens.name: backdrop-sky
tokens.usage: Top of the bright Backdrop gradient. Surfaces only.

tokens.name: backdrop-sky-2
tokens.usage: Backdrop gradient at 28%.

tokens.name: backdrop-horizon
tokens.usage: Backdrop gradient at 44%, where the light streak sits.

tokens.name: backdrop-lake
tokens.usage: Backdrop gradient at 60%.

tokens.name: backdrop-ground
tokens.usage: Backdrop gradient at 80%.

tokens.name: backdrop-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the Backdrop gradient, under body text and buttons.

tokens.name: backdrop-bloom
tokens.usage: Violet bloom in the top left corner of the Backdrop.

tokens.name: streak-warm
tokens.usage: Warm left end of the horizon light streak.

tokens.name: streak-warm-2
tokens.usage: Second warm stop of the streak.

tokens.name: streak-cool
tokens.usage: Cool middle of the streak and the haze above it.

tokens.name: streak-cool-2
tokens.usage: Cool right end of the streak, fading out.

tokens.name: streak-core-hot
tokens.usage: Bright thin core of the streak, left side.

tokens.name: streak-core-cool
tokens.usage: Bright thin core of the streak, right side.

tokens.name: backdrop-floor
tokens.usage: Soft band below the horizon.

tokens.name: backdrop-cast
tokens.usage: Violet shadow cast by the glowing object.

tokens.name: backdrop-vignette
tokens.usage: Darkening at the bottom of the Backdrop so white text reads. Also the fill behind text panels on the Backdrop.

tokens.name: thermal-white
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-yellow
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-amber
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-orange
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-red
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-green
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

tokens.name: thermal-deep
tokens.usage: Heat map ramp for the blurred Backdrop objects only. Never for UI, text or status.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: The Melos number on the day of the show, in accent. Tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big line on a screen: event day, welcome line. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: You and Maya can make it

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The text logo only. Always lowercase, always ink.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Late night R&B, Bay Area rap
styles.usage: Card titles: artist name, event name, taste summary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You both have Faye Lindqvist on repeat.
styles.usage: Running text, chat bubbles, button labels at 17px semibold.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasis inside body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata: price range, venue, distance, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Progress, timestamps, attribution lines. Never below 13px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, chat bubble spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small cards, the screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on match and concert cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height and width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, info rows, image slots inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the Spotify button, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the Canvas gradient.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: A selected concert card or a fresh invitation. One per screen.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Noise layer (assets/grain.png, overlay blend) over the Canvas and Backdrop. Keep it subtle: 0.10 to 0.18.

tokens.name: pattern-opacity
tokens.usage: Ceiling for a school pattern or image in the Canvas slot.

tokens.name: object-blur
tokens.usage: Blur on the glowing Backdrop object.
